Detailed Description

template<class RecircBaseType>
class RecircBaseChain< RecircBaseType >

Creat a chain of allpass or comb delays.

Template Parameters:
RecircBaseType This must be one of the following (otherwise you may get very strange errors): CombN, CombL, AllpassN, AllpassL. This will be used as the delay type.

Construct and audio rate RecircBaseChain chain.

Parameters:
input The input to the chain.
size The number of links in the chain.
maximumDelayTime The maximum size of the delay unit in seconds.
delayTime The delay time in seconds. This is a Value class so will be evaluated for each link created (for most purposes some kind of random value would be useful here).
decayTime The decay time to decay by 60dB (in seconds). This is a Value class so will be evaluated for each link created. It may beuseful to use a random value here too.
